# typst-doc

> Render R, Python, Typst, and Unix manual-page documentation as Typst.

## Pages

- [typst-doc](https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/typst-doc/): typst-doc renders R, Python, Typst, and Unix manual-page documentation as Typst markup.
- [Reference](https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/typst-doc/reference.html): The typst-doc manual page, rendered as Typst by typst-doc itself.
